text: Think about how extraordinary that is. You began by losing one way of understanding the world. But with time, practice, and the right support, you learned to use information you once ignored. Not every blind person uses echolocation. And learning it doesn't give anyone supernatural abilities. But for some people, reflected sound can become a genuinely useful part of navigating space. The world hasn't become visible again. You've simply learned a different way to understand part of it.
